facts.en: Completed a certificate in Retail Operations at Fictional Institute D029 in 2025.
facts.zh: 2025 年在虚构院校 D029 完成零售运营结业证书。

facts.en: Worked part-time as a stock assistant at Fictional Shop D029 from 2025-06 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2025-06 至 2026-08 在虚构商店 D029 兼职担任库存助理。

facts.en: Checked inbound cartons against delivery notes and reported damaged packaging to the shift lead.
facts.zh: 依据送货单检查入库纸箱，并向班次负责人报告包装损坏。

facts.en: Used a handheld scanner to record stock movements and followed assigned shelf-location codes.
facts.zh: 使用手持扫描器记录库存移动，并遵循指定货架位置编码。

facts.en: Helped relabel 60 shelf positions in one stockroom zone using an approved location map.
facts.zh: 依据获批位置图，协助为一个库房区域的 60 个货架位置重新贴标。

facts.en: In 20 sampled retrievals from that zone, median lookup time decreased from 4 minutes to 3 minutes after relabeling; the shift team performed the work.
facts.zh: 重新贴标后，在该区域抽样的 20 次取货中，查找时间中位数从 4 分钟降至 3 分钟；工作由班次团队完成。

facts.en: Supported weekly cycle counts and passed variances to the stock controller rather than changing balances independently.
facts.zh: 协助每周循环盘点，并将差异提交库存管理员，而非独立调整余额。

facts.en: Has not supervised staff or operated a forklift.
facts.zh: 未监督员工，也未操作叉车。
